notes.title: Update 05/30/2018
notes.content:
Added HighScroce Counter to Each Level in Home Menu.

Added Text To Show What score is needed to unlock each level.

Made Object and In levels easy to grab in Smaller place Spaces.

Turned Down the Linear dampening on Objects so that they can bee throw much higher.

How the Controllers Work made Slightly larger since it seems to go unnoticed.

How to play Video the game was added to the About game section.

And Added A Basic Steam Leader Board So know you can Show us What You Got
